description: This file contains Sass mixins for form validation styling, including visual states, tooltips, feedback messages, and validation icons.

methods.name: form-validation-state-selector
methods.description: A mixin that defines styling for form validation states depending on the given state ('valid' or 'invalid').

methods.name: form-validation-state
methods.description: A mixin that styles feedback messages, tooltips, and input controls based on validation state, color, icon, and other parameters.
